doc.description:
INS and AHRS using the EKF2 of PX4.
The EKF2 and the PX4 libraries it needs are copied in sw/ext/px4_ekf2, where sync_px4_ekf2.py updates them to another PX4 version (see PX4_VERSION there). The GNSS quality checks (GPS_CHECK_MASK and GPS_REQ_*) are the ones of PX4.

define.name: INS_EKF2_OPTITRACK
define.description: Easy configuration of full optitrack (position- and yaw fusion, height, init origin)

define.name: INS_EKF2_FUSION_MODE
define.description: Sensors used for fusion: MASK_USE_GPS, MASK_USE_GPSYAW, MASK_USE_OF, MASK_USE_EVPOS, MASK_USE_EVVEL, MASK_USE_EVYAW, MASK_USE_DRAG, MASK_INHIBIT_ACC_BIAS

define.name: INS_EKF2_MAG_FUSION_TYPE
define.description: Magnetometer fusion type (MAG_FUSE_TYPE_INDOOR and _3D of the previous version map to NONE and AUTO)

define.name: INS_EKF2_VDIST_SENSOR_TYPE
define.description: Primary sensor used for vertical distance

define.name: INS_EKF2_GPS_CHECK_MASK
